title: Galen
summary: Galen is a Native Kumeyaay Huntik Foundation archaeologist based in Baja California, Mexico. He and his brother, Teeg, are both experts on the famous conqueror, Hernán Cortés.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
A native Seeker, Galen and his brother grew up in Baja California, Mexico and eventually became allies of the Huntik Foundation. Galen trained with his brother in New York City with the Foundation, but stood out as they had learnt their powers through their ancient traditions. [The Power of Umbra]

Galen and Teeg helped Dante Vale find the entrance to Hernán Cortés' vault using their extensive charts and records [Gremlow Infestation!]

Galen and Teeg later hosted Dante Vale and his team in Yucatan, and helped them to find the Ring of the Legendary Titan of Dimensions, Umbra. [The Power of Umbra]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Galen is a studious academic and dedicated to his research on [[Umbra]], the Titan of Dimensions. Compared to his more adventurous brother, Galen is more scholarly and serious. He and Teeg were very kind hosts to the Huntik team and he was concerned about their safety when their mission was taking longer than expected. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

full_text:
Galen is a Native Kumeyaay Huntik Foundation archaeologist based in Baja California, Mexico. He and his brother, Teeg, are both experts on the famous conqueror, Hernán Cortés.

== History ==
A native Seeker, Galen and his brother grew up in Baja California, Mexico and eventually became allies of the Huntik Foundation. Galen trained with his brother in New York City with the Foundation, but stood out as they had learnt their powers through their ancient traditions. [The Power of Umbra]

Galen and Teeg helped Dante Vale find the entrance to Hernán Cortés' vault using their extensive charts and records [Gremlow Infestation!]

Galen and Teeg later hosted Dante Vale and his team in Yucatan, and helped them to find the Ring of the Legendary Titan of Dimensions, Umbra. [The Power of Umbra]

== Personality ==
Galen is a studious academic and dedicated to his research on Umbra, the Titan of Dimensions. Compared to his more adventurous brother, Galen is more scholarly and serious. He and Teeg were very kind hosts to the Huntik team and he was concerned about their safety when their mission was taking longer than expected. [The Power of Umbra]

== Abilities ==
Galen is an expert on history, particularly that of Hernán Cortés. His research and knowledge of the Yucatan is second to none and was invaluable to Huntik team in their quest to recover the Ring of Umbra.
